# Font fixture

`HankenGrotesk-Subset.ttf` is a subset of Hanken Grotesk (variable font,
`wght` axis) by the Hanken Grotesk Project Authors, licensed under the SIL Open
Font License 1.1 (see `OFL.txt` in this directory). It was subsetted with
harfbuzz (hb-subset) to ASCII, Latin-1 Supplement, general punctuation, arrows,
and a handful of stars/checkmarks, keeping the variation tables, purely to keep
the committed fixture small (~64 KB). The full font is available at
https://github.com/marcologous/hanken-grotesk and via Google Fonts.
